journey.name: wear quickpay on app start
journey.description:
A payment link that starts the app is paid under QuickPay too: the watch reads the settings it last imported from the phone, however long ago, as the phone reads its own, and fetches the rates it does not keep across a restart before it decides. The send goes out without the review and the hold. Emulator, or a physical watch that stays on the wrist and unlocked.
Precondition: run quickpay-skips-hold.xml first, so the watch's last import has QuickPay on with Default Unit Bitcoin, Denomination Modern and Local Currency USD, which the amount below counts on, and change nothing on the phone since. Watch: the wallet of quickpay-skips-hold.xml on the local ./spark stack with at least 2 000 sats and a network on which the balance comes back within 20 s of a start. A wallet that needs more than 30 s shows the review and the hold instead, which is as designed and fails this journey. So does a locked watch: KEYCODE_WAKEUP lights the screen and unlocks nothing, and QuickPay never pays on a locked watch.

actions.action: Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 200` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`, which starts the app
Wait up to 40 s until "WatchSendSent" is listed, touching nothing
Verify `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear` lists "Skipped the hold to pay under QuickPay"
